reviews.text:
Enjoy food stalls on the forest path of Insadong-gil.
Spacious seating and a variety of snacks.
A great drinking spot both in winter and summer.

This is a food stall located at the beginning and end of Insadong-gil, at the entrance to Insadong-gil from Geumgang Emperor at Jongno 2-ga intersection. As many bars with this atmosphere are disappearing, this is a place where young people and a variety of customers visit from early evening until late.

As it is a food stall, you can enjoy a variety of dishes, from inexpensive menus to seafood and fusion dishes. There are plenty of seats, and even though it is a food stall, the restrooms are separated for men and women. As a tip, the Jjajangmyeon restaurant across the street is also a good place to finish at a reasonable price.

Payment by credit card is also possible, and there seems to be a discount if you pay in cash.

reviews.author: h.y k
reviews.text: The taste and service are the worst. I heard that they cannot take orders for noodles (ramen, udon, etc.) during busy times, but I guess it depends on the employee taking the order. The tables around us who arrived later than us were still ordering and eating. I was trying to order a side to one main menu item, but the table next to me was able to do so. When we asked why we couldn't, he seemed embarrassed and couldn't explain it in a way that was understandable, so he just left the table without explaining what he was saying. If you want to run a proper business without getting criticized, properly train your employees so that they can treat all customers with the same standards.

reviews.author: Yap yap min min
reviews.text: I don't know if they are only friendly to tables with a large number of people, or if they are only friendly to tables that ordered menus and lots of alcohol, but if a small number of people go and order something, they notice it^^ When we went to a small number of people and asked if they could order noodles and other items on the menu, they clearly said no and said they couldn't cook the food themselves, but they were eating the large tables that arrived later than us. Get some orders consistently. It would be nice if you could at least serve us kindly. Before I even finish speaking, I draw an X on the order form, say no, and leave. I went in in a good mood after meeting a friend for the first time in a while, but my mood worsened and I left all the drinks and snacks behind. And when I told the boss about this, he said he would provide more service. I didn't say I wanted to receive service, but I wanted to hear that he was sorry that he would correct it, but it seems like I was a person who complained because I couldn't receive service.^^ I hope the service responds and corrects it.

reviews.author: 首尔上门服务Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: This restaurant boasts an elegant atmosphere with a simple yet sophisticated interior and soft lighting, making it perfect for a couple's date or a small gathering with friends. Experienced waiters provide friendly and attentive service, and food comes out at a reasonable pace. In particular, the recommended menu item, braised pork ribs, is a must-order. It has a perfect balance of lean meat and fat, so it has a texture that melts in your mouth, and it tastes best when eaten with rice. Steamed sea bass is perfectly cooked with fresh ingredients so you can feel the tenderness of the fish meat. The crème brûlée served as dessert is also excellent. However, the price range is a bit high, and the portion size may be a bit small for men who eat a lot. Overall, it's not the best value for money, but the consistent food quality and comfortable dining atmosphere makes it worth a visit every now and then for a special occasion. I definitely want to come back next time with my friends.

reviews.text: This bar in Seoul boasts a warm and elegant design, perfectly matched lighting and music, and a great atmosphere, making it a place you'll want to stay for a long time. The Japanese staff provides professional and attentive service in a friendly and courteous manner, and the owner's warm hospitality makes guests feel at home. The signature cocktails are a perfect blend of creativity and flavor, and the food is also delicious using high-quality ingredients. A comfortable meeting with friends can be a very enjoyable and relaxing time here. The average price per person is approximately 30,000 to 50,000 won. The price range is a bit wide, but considering the overall atmosphere, service, and quality, it is good value for money. Demonstrating a high level of professionalism in everything from the atmosphere to the service to the quality of the drinks, this is a great place to enjoy Seoul's nightlife, and is a place I would definitely visit again and highly recommend to my friends.

reviews.author: FNH
reviews.text:
“Atmosphere rather than taste. Time travel next to Jongmyo Shrine.”

Jongmyo Haejangguk is a place that maintains its presence with its atmosphere rather than the taste of the food.
There are menu items such as hangover soup and stir-fried pork, but the taste is below expectations. The broth was bland and the meat was average. It definitely doesn't suit foreign tastes.

Nevertheless, there is only one reason to come here: the atmosphere.
Quiet back road next to Jongmyo Shrine, outdoor bench, table on floor…
It has a retro feel, as if you've traveled back in time to Seoul in the 70s and 80s.

If you go around 7pm, you can sit down without waiting.
If you are late, the line will be quite long.

The price is quite expensive, and there are many Haejangguk restaurants that are better for similar money.

Recommended only in spring and fall when the weather is nice (April-May, September-October).
It is hot in the summer and cold in the winter, so it is not recommended.

Rather than a date, it's a great place to go quietly with close friends to have a glass of soju.

Recommended for those who enjoy wine or are sensitive to food quality.

It's worth going once, but I'm not sure about going twice.

If you want to ‘experience’ the old sensibility in the middle of downtown Seoul, it is worth a visit for that purpose alone.

There seemed to be less than 10 tables in the wine bar, which was a renovated hanok, and the atmosphere was comfortable and had the charm of a hanok. It was a good place for a date or a gathering with a few close friends.
The food was a fusion style using Italian and Korean ingredients, and the wines ranged from natural to red and white, with the highest price being around 80,000-90,000 won, which was listed at an affordable price range.
The food was overall delicious. The seasoning was well-balanced without being too strong, and it was cooked well to bring out the texture. Even if it was a regular restaurant rather than a bar, it was so tasty that it could be called a good restaurant.
This is a place I would like to visit again.

reviews.text:
A small bar/restaurant with the main purpose of listening to music on the second floor located at the entrance of Seosunla-gil.

This place mainly serves food for lunch and alcohol for dinner.
The only signboard is a small sign, so it is not conspicuous.

The menu is surprisingly diverse and plentiful, and the music descriptions and instructions are written in a complicated way before the menu, but there are so many things that must be followed that it can be a bit repulsive, and there are many restrictions such as limiting the serving time to 1 hour and 30 minutes in the evening.

The audio doesn't feel very well-equipped, but it is pleasing to the eye as the music matches the video on the monitor.

There are about 7 chairs at the bar and about 5 tables, including seats in every corner.

The restroom is inside, and it seems to have a similar feel to the store starting with Micro Eo-blah in Euljiro. The stickers handed out there can be seen right here, so I wonder if they are familiar with it.

The owner played music, cooked, and served food all by himself, so it seemed quite hectic, and there were quite a lot of people in the evening, even on weekdays.

The audio volume is not very loud, but the volume is well adjusted to suit the space and the music.

It appears that the rooftop is also in operation during the day and when the weather is good, but I have never been there.

I intend to visit again, but the 1 hour and 30 minute limit is a bit long each time.
A place I would like to visit on a quiet weekday day.

reviews.text: A wine bar with a lively atmosphere in an alley. A variety of wines and matching snacks. The price is a bit... haha

reviews.author: love
reviews.text:
Thanks to the handsome and nice owner, it is a very comfortable and nice place whether you visit alone or with a group.
The owner can speak not only Korean, but also Japanese and English, so foreigners can use it comfortably.
You can also choose from alcohol such as highballs, beer, whiskey, wine, and even sake and Chinese liquor.
Non-alcoholic beverages are also available.
The owner is both skilled and skilled, so the drinks he makes himself, such as highballs, are good and taste good.
The interior is full of Hanok sensibility and the music is not loud, making it good for conversation.

reviews.author: Kjetil Landrog
reviews.text: I couldn't go in because I wasn't a member. But when I went somewhere else, I heard that membership was only for gay people... Am I gay? Yes, of course. That's why you went there. There just happened to be an empty seat. I guess it's a place only Koreans go to. It would be nice to at least hang a sign outside. Foreigners, especially people with different skin colors, are not allowed. I guess this is a place where only Koreans are welcome!

reviews.author: Sam foo
reviews.text: It's a cozy and cozy place for a quick drink after dinner. The bar owner is really friendly and cute!

reviews.text:
full of tigers
A place where many people go for muscle training
The owner's younger brother is good at drawing pictures of tigers and beasts (mascot type), and the goods are also good.
He said he even wrote a thesis on drawings of tigers and beasts, but he doesn't want to acknowledge his work as furry haha.

reviews.author: bok_gil
reviews.text: Recommended if you want a quiet feel. There is a wide range of signatures and cocktails. The owners are young, so you can feel comfortable. Personally, I recommend the menus of Cinnabro and Treasure.

reviews.author: Jihun Ryu
reviews.text: The atmosphere is nice, the owner is friendly, and I recommend it in many ways!

reviews.author: Viktoria

I really like this place
I went with my friend

The atmosphere is so good too

reviews.author: Maximo Pereyra Iraola
reviews.text: It was a really beautiful bar, the atmosphere was great and the snacks were great. However, I had an uncomfortable experience with someone who seemed to be the boss. We were filming inside the bar for a bit (it was really cool and full of fun props and details) and I think he thought we were trying to film or take pictures of him. Anyway, he told me I couldn't take pictures of his face, so I immediately apologized and put my phone down, but he didn't even look at us for the hour we sat at the bar. Everyone else seems to be enjoying it, so I still want to recommend it. I think we were unlucky and unintentionally offended him. One of the other bartenders was really friendly. I intend to visit again next time, but honestly, I didn't feel welcome. The cocktails looked really delicious, but we only drank beer.

reviews.author: K Kang
reviews.text:
It's a small but good bar. This is a great bar to unwind after work. It's great to have a drink when you can't sleep and then go home. Classic cocktails are great, but signature cocktails are also worth trying.

In particular, it is on the first floor with a large window, so the biggest advantage is that you can see the cats outside and have a drink while looking at the quiet alley. I'm going to have a delicious and comfortable drink today as well.

reviews.author: Minkyoo Park
reviews.text:
If you want to drink delicious cocktails in a relaxed atmosphere, I recommend this place.
The new cocktails the owner develops each season are also interesting.
Above all, the cocktail quality is good. It tastes like a lot of know-how and time spent thinking about it.
A place that leaves me satisfied every time I go!

reviews.author: Seonghoon Park
reviews.text: Fun owner, delicious drinks, simple and warm space.

reviews.author: joon kim
reviews.text: It's truly a gem of a bar. The cocktails are top notch, and the original recipes using Korean ingredients are truly delicious. The atmosphere was warm and cozy, which was nice. I will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Young gun Kim
reviews.text:
It's a cozy and lovely place.

The warm vodka cocktail recommended by the owner was really delicious.
It's hidden in an alley, but it's worth a visit thanks to its quiet and comfortable atmosphere.

reviews.text: A place with great atmosphere. It’s a pleasant and atmospheric place to have a glass of wine when the weather is nice! The food is a bit disappointing

reviews.author: Hahahahohoho

I went because the terrace was so pretty.
However, since the food was Korean fusion, it didn't go well with the wine, so there wasn't anything worth eating.
But the staff was friendly and the atmosphere was nice.

Nice place and you dont have to order its food as you can bring your own food

This restaurant is suitable for a quick wine and meal after visiting Changdeokgung Palace.

reviews.text: A wine bar where you can enjoy wine at a reasonable price. It was a little cold inside, but the workers were friendly and I felt good. I ordered several bottles and the owner also gave me a cheese plate, which I was thankful for.

reviews.author: Kyuwon Lee
reviews.text: Delightful retro style, intimate, den-like atmosphere and simple but classic drinks menu.

reviews.author: Rodolfo Granados
reviews.text: Sometimes you just need a nice, clean bar where you can have a cold beer. A lot of bars in town require you to order food when you order a drink, but I just want the drink, not the food. The draft beer here is the coolest and the atmosphere is great. It's hard to find because there's no sign, but it's underground.

address: Basement 1, 33 Changdeokgung 1-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Unu
reviews.text:
It’s been a long time since I’ve been to such a unique place~
They sell aged beer, usually beer over 10 percent. They sell 665-750ml large beers, and the prices range from 30,000 won to 60,000 won. Maybe it’s because it’s not a regular beer, but a beer aged in oak barrels… It’s especially delicious~ I had dragon milk… It was delicious~
If you want something unique, please visit once. I think I will go often... It's a feeling!

reviews.author: jihyon bae
reviews.text:
🎞️ It is a small, unique bar run by an owner who is serious about movies. The handcrafted menu is pretty, but it's a bit difficult to figure out what kind of beer they serve.
🙍🏻‍♀️🍺 Unfortunately, since beer comes in every Monday, there are not many beers available for ordering on Sunday.. (+It's more expensive than other stores, so it's a bit burdensome)
🍫 Many of the snacks that could be ordered were already sold out, so the options were limited.
⏰ If possible, I think it would be better to visit on a weekday evening rather than a Sunday evening! The owner is friendly and the atmosphere is fun.

reviews.author: Sanghyun Park
reviews.text: A place where you can enjoy a unique beer experience

reviews.author: Yeonju Hong
reviews.text:
Even if I go back after a year, I believe what it says on Naver that it opens on weekends at 6 o'clock.
They just told me it wasn't business hours, so I thought I'd never go again until I die.
Please correct the false listing of weekend opening hours to 'real opening hours' or honestly say that we are open at the owner's discretion.

reviews.author: 姜太
reviews.text: The space was very comfortable, and it was open until late. Surprisingly, the fried noodles were really delicious.

reviews.author: Belle T
reviews.text: The first night I arrived in Seoul, I happened to find Oni while looking for a Naver map. It was near the hotel. There was a very classic jazz atmosphere and classic cocktails were also served. I had a Moscow Mule and my wife had an Old Fashioned. There are classic cocktails on the menu, and I could feel a very old-fashioned atmosphere while drinking them.

reviews.author: Yechan Lee
reviews.text:
I really like this place.
It feels cozy and comfortable.
It's also great for talking with friends while listening to calm jazz music.

The price is very reasonable too.

reviews.author: Matboard Chart
reviews.text:
A court that makes sense right from its name. My first eye was drawn to the courthouse in front of the Constitutional Court, and when I opened the menu, my second eye lit up at the bourbon whiskey and lime. A unique bar restaurant where you will be surprised three times by the taste of whiskey that changes from rich sweetness to mild when you take a sip on the rocks and a bite of tiramisu.
The atmosphere is retro and quiet, so it's great for talking. This is a cool Jongno bar that you will save after one visit and promise for the next!!!

reviews.author: macaroni cat
reviews.text:
I think it's a bar specializing in bourbon whiskey.
There are also original cocktails(?)
There was also Korean whiskey, so it was nice to taste two or three glasses at a time.
The tiramisu I ordered as a snack was also delicious.
I went on a weekday around 4-5pm and there was no one there and it was quiet.
It was better!

Let's enjoy the rain, enjoy the beautiful taste, and enjoy the beautiful taste.
It's okay to say goodbye to the day.
It's expensive, it's expensive, it's high!

reviews.author: Woohyun Kim
reviews.text:
I never thought there would be a bar with this kind of atmosphere in a place like this...
‘Courthouse Bar’ specializes in bourbon whiskey. The name is unique and the atmosphere is overwhelming.
The prices are similar to the first bar, but the attentive service and the unique simplicity of the Japanese tatami room atmosphere allow for good drinks and conversation.
They also gave us cheesecake as a service... A place I want to go again.
However, it would be better if they also served Scotch whiskey... but it is a disappointing place.

reviews.author: Lee Joo-won
reviews.text:
“A bar but no bar”
It is a bar court with no seating in rows.
I think it would be a good idea to go and see the origin of the name.
Personally, I think it would be a great date course.
The main menu is mainly bourbon-centered whiskey and cocktails, and the meat and apple pie are truly delicious.
They also sell wine and beer, so if you can't drink whiskey or cocktails, this would be perfect.

reviews.author: Bar_ Tyon
reviews.text:
This is a bar in Gyedong. The name is funny: Bourbon Court.
It has a nice atmosphere and is said to be in the same category as German House and Omusa.
There are a variety of beers and cocktails. It tastes good too.
There is even a Supreme Court, so I recommend trying a variety of foods.
The snacks feel a little expensive, and since the bar is not open, you can't see how they are made.
